events.title: Yukon River Camp, YT
events.thought: End of day fifty-eight. The Dempster unwinds north.

events.title: Tombstone Range from the Ridge
events.thought: Standing above Tombstone Park's valley — those dark spires live rent-free in your head forever.
events.photoCaption: A hiker looks out from an alpine ridge over the jagged Tombstone peaks and glacial valley, Yukon.
